result.topic_en: Euler completes the determination of the force on the fixed end A of an elastic lamina in a particular solution, then remarks that the lamina can be fixed in many other ways (at one or both ends, by a wall or a pin, even at intermediate points), giving several kinds of vibration to be treated in the following problems.
